metricDefinitions.label: Fact + label F1
metricDefinitions.definition: 2TP/(2TP+FP+FN). Wrong labels count as both FP and FN. Candidate labels use unchanged owner-aligned text; this is not new owner approval.

metricDefinitions.label: False support
metricDefinitions.definition: Non-supported gold facts predicted SUPPORTED / all non-supported gold facts. Coverage and success remain visible.

metricDefinitions.label: Evidence sufficiency
metricDefinitions.definition: Sufficient evidence units / all supported or contradicted prediction units. Unknown for candidate-wide results until reviewed.

metricDefinitions.label: Error units
metricDefinitions.definition: Scoring units after the owner's compound split. Error types overlap. Compound marks repeat prediction-level issues; do not add error totals.
